programs.title: Adam Richman Eats Britain
programs.desc: In Wales, Adam tries Glamorgan sausage in Glamorgan. He enjoys Welsh rarebit and wonderful Welsh cakes, and bites into his Polish heritage with pierogis.

programs.title: Buddy Valastro's Cake Dynasty
programs.desc: When Buddy gets a request from Anthony Shriver to create a cake for the Best Buddies Challenge, he's thrilled; the team runs into some difficulties when this cake has to travel on a bumpy sea plane.

programs.title: Destination Flavour Singapore Bitesize
programs.desc: The best bits of Adam Liaw's travels in Singapore, as he explores its vibrant food scene.

programs.title: Kriol Kitchen
programs.sub_title: Helani Doolah: Sop Sop, Sabee Domboi, And Marinated Fried Fish With Battered Banana
programs.desc: Using knowledge from her grandmother and other family members, Helani Doolah will show and teach us how to make some staple dishes that are made every day in the Torres Strait Islander community.

programs.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programs.desc: You may not know that you've been eating Tonkatsu for years, Let Rachel reintroduce you to her version of the dish also known as, fried pork chops, served with an umami rich sauce.

programs.title: My Market Kitchen
programs.desc: Laura is in the stunning Adelaide Hills and cooks up an Italian delight, Ricotta and Silver beet Gnudi, while Matt makes a very tasty Welsh Rarebit.
